task.description:
Validate the design artefact src/design/iss102-tasks-claimed-by.md for ISS-102.

Verify:
1. All 4 acceptance criteria from ISS-102 have a design element:
   - claimed_by UUID NULL column + migration DDL
   - Claim endpoint UPDATE guard (claimed_by IS NULL AND status='PENDING') → 409 on 0 rows
   - Completion guard: only claimed_by (or USER-assigned assignee_ref) may complete
   - Both partial indexes (unclaimed-pool, my-tasks by claimed_by)
2. No implementation code present (no Zig function bodies, no SQL DML)
3. All public function signatures listed for store.zig and tasks.zig changes
4. Error taxonomy specified
5. Design is sufficient for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity
acceptance_criteria: PASS: all ISS-102 acceptance criteria covered in design
PASS: no implementation code in design artefact
FAIL if any criterion is missing or design is ambiguous

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/iss102-tasks-claimed-by.md validated — all 4 ISS-102 acceptance criteria covered: claimed_by column DDL (§2.1), UPDATE guard with exact WHERE predicate and 409 on 0 rows (§3.2-3.3), completion authorization three-branch guard (§4.2), both partial indexes with WHERE predicates (§2.2-2.3). Lint exits 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR issues. Function signatures complete for claimTask, handleClaim, handleComplete, completeInTx, getById, createInTx. Error taxonomy in §5 with HTTP mapping table. Security: parameterized SQL noted explicitly.
